subject: Cross-cloud partner demo: dry-run scheduling & recording rotation
messages:

Cc: partner-ops@cloudmarketplace.io
Date: 2026-07-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood intro — co-sell demo request

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the intro earlier. Solentech's engineering and sales teams want a joint demo that shows the Redwood Dedicated + our SI integration on AWS and a short failover sketch on GCP. Can we schedule a technical dry-run the week before the customer-facing session so we validate auth, recording, and runbook handoffs?

Two asks: 1) Can Redwood own the demo recording and provide retention to meet our procurement needs (90 days)? 2) Can we run a 45-min dry-run with at least one SI engineer + Redwood ops on the line?

Our preferred windows next week (all CEST): Tue 2026-07-21 10:00–11:00, Wed 11:00–12:00, Thu 14:00–15:00.

Marcus
Sr. Partnerships, Solentech
marcus@solentech.com

Thanks Marcus — we can absolutely run the dry-run.

Quick notes:
- We can host the recording and set retention to 90 days; I’ll need confirmation on storage SLA from Ops (cc'ed Kimberly & Naomi).
- 45-min dry-run sounds right: 10–15 min infra/auth checks, 25 min run-through, 5–10 min rollback/fallback verification.

Proposed times I can commit to: Wed 2026-07-22 11:00–11:45 CEST, Thu 2026-07-23 14:00–14:45 CEST. I dropped the times into a short ICS (attached) and the runbook draft (redwood-dryrun-runbook-v1.pdf).

Can Kimberly/Naomi confirm: who will be the recording owner (Redwood vs. Solentech) for access requests, and do we need a short legal acceptance note for 90-day retention?

If all good, I’ll lock the calendar and add the SI contact.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

Aditya / Naomi —

We can own the recording for the dry-run and set retention to 90 days. Two operational caveats:
1) If Solentech requests access to the raw recording, we need a short access request email and retention SLA acknowledgment (legal prefers < 2 lines).
2) For cross-cloud failover segments (AWS -> GCP), we'd like the SI to run the failover once in the dry-run while Redwood monitors latency and KV cache behavior.

I’ll pre-populate the runbook with the recording owner language and the access request template (see Drive link you provided). Naomi, can you confirm the storage label and whether encryption with customer-managed keys is required for this customer?

Kimberly Park
Partner Ops — Redwood Inference

- Dry-run length: 45 mins.
- Participants required: Redwood ops (Aditya), Partner Ops (Kimberly), SI engineer (Solentech), Sales + Solutions (Marcus + 1)
- Tech checklist: AWS creds, GCP failover service account, console sharing flow, recording check, screen share role check.

Marcus — Thu 2026-07-23 14:00–14:45 CEST works for us. Please confirm SI engineer name and we’ll send a calendar invite and preflight doc (I attached the runbook update).
